headline: A 3.60 TL Tax Increase on Diesel Is Expected on September 1
summary: The special consumption tax (ÖTV) on diesel, temporarily set to zero, is due to be reinstated on September 1. A 3.60 lira increase per litre including VAT is expected.
why: Fuel taxes and prices feed into transport costs, inflation and household spending in Turkey, one of the country's most sensitive price items.
